scope: old/spec (base.tla, MC.tla, Update.tla, Trace.tla, *.cfg) maintained against update.patch (old/source -> new/source). No tests/TLC executed; no code/spec changed.
update_summary: U-A learners may cast (Pre)Votes: isLearner short-circuit removed from raft.Step (new/source/raft.go:924-960); TestLearnerCannotVote -> TestLearnerCanVote.

U-B newRaft and raft.restore rebuild the tracker via confchange.Restore(ConfState) and panic unless the result is Equivalent to the input (new/source/raft.go:332-367, 1431-1446; util.go:137-143; confchange/restore.go; raftpb/confstate.go). Joint state (VotersOutgoing, LearnersNext, AutoLeave) now survives restart and snapshot restore; previously only Nodes/Learners were restored.

U-C RawNode.Ready() now accepts the Ready (clears raft.msgs, readStates, sets prevSoftSt); RawNode.Advance() no longer calls acceptReady (new/source/rawnode.go:119-177; TestRawNodeConsumeReady). node.run uses readyWithoutAccept + acceptReady-at-send + Advance (behaviour identical to old commitReady path).
U-D ConfState field rename Nodes->Voters, NodesJoint->VotersOutgoing (same proto tags 1..5, same marshal order, so encoded sizes unchanged); ProgressTracker.ConfState() helper.
U-E ProgressTracker.Visit iterates in sorted id order (tracker/tracker.go:191-210).

U-F No-semantic refactors: majority.go CommittedIndex slice setup, EnterJoint brace removal, logger mutex, node.Tick warning text, NewRawNode ID==0 check removed (still rejected by Config.validate, raft.go:211-213).

overall_decision.reason: Most of the suite still states the right contract and stays as is, including all core safety controls. Two contracts changed semantically: learners may now vote (VoteContract, LearnerEligibility.grants), and RawNode now accepts at Ready instead of Advance (ReadyOwnership, plus a new Advance-preservation obligation). One observer must migrate (ReadyAccounting.lostReads at Advance). The restore-fidelity property only checked joint configs; strengthen it to every restore, matching assertConfStatesEquivalent. The old joint-recovery canary flips role. Three update-related obligations are not expressed by any old property: snapshot admission for VotersOutgoing members, at most one in-flight auto-leave, and non-vacuity canaries for learner grants and joint restores. Two of these are expected to expose implementation defects in new/source. Do not weaken them to make the source pass.

semantic_requirement_changes: LearnerEligibility grants conjunct (remove conjunct; campaigns conjunct kept)
representation_or_observer_migrations: ReadyAccounting: lostReads observer at Advance (predicate unchanged)
ConfState field rename (instrumentation/comment mapping only; model record already uses voters/outgoing)
Visit ordering (unobservable in bag semantics; no edit)
pre_existing_property_defect_repairs: JointRecoveryNotReached role flip (canary for the old defect -> regression invariant) + JointRestoreNotReached canary
AutoLeaveSingleFlight (add): AutoLeaveAdvance's eligibility is implementation-relative and cannot see duplicate leave appends
new_update_obligations: SnapshotAdmission (add; restore now supports joint ConfStates but the admission check ignores VotersOutgoing)

entries.name: VoteDecisionEligibility (operator VoteContract)

evidence.source: old/source/raft.go:922-928 returned without a response when r.isLearner; new/source/raft.go:924-960 removes that branch and applies canVote/isUpToDate to learners, with a comment that this is necessary for a promoted-but-unaware learner.
evidence.tests: new/source/raft_test.go:381-397 TestLearnerCanVote (renamed from TestLearnerCannotVote). Its final assertion `msg.Type != MsgVoteResp && !msg.Reject` passes for ANY MsgVoteResp, granted or rejected, so the test proves only that a response is emitted. The grant obligation therefore has to live in VoteContract.
evidence.contract: Learners respond to MsgVote/MsgPreVote exactly as voters do: same lease suppression, stale-term handling, term reset, canVote and log freshness. Only the learner-specific silence goes away.

entries.proposed_expression: grant==~lease /\ ~stale /\ fresh /\ can ; silence==lease \/ (stale /\ m.type="MsgVote") ; all other LET definitions and the IN conjuncts (o.responses=expected /\ o.afterTerm=t /\ o.afterVote=IF grant /\ m.type="MsgVote" THEN m.from ELSE v) unchanged. VoteObservation keeps the learner field as an unused ghost.

Transition: Receive(MsgVote{from:s1,to:s3,term:3,index:Last(s1),logTerm:Term(s1,Last(s1))}), where s1's log is at least as up to date as s3's.

entries.name: ReadyAccounting (history.lostReads observer)

evidence.source: base.tla:1102-1103 computes lostReads at Advance as SeqSet(r.readStates)\SeqSet(application[n].reads) for RawNodes, on the assumption that Advance clears readStates. That assumption is false for new/source/rawnode.go:170-177.
evidence.contract: Unchanged: no ReadState is discarded without being delivered.

entries.old_expression: lostReads' = lostReads \cup (IF n\in RawNodes /\ b.reads# <<>> THEN SeqSet(r.readStates)\SeqSet(application[n].reads) ELSE {}) ; ReadyAccounting == /\ history.lostReads={} /\ ...
entries.proposed_expression: lostReads' = lostReads \cup (SeqSet(r.readStates) \ (SeqSet(a.readStates) \cup SeqSet(application[n].reads))) for every n. ReadyAccounting predicate text unchanged.

disagreement_witness.state_or_transition: RawNode leader s1: ReadIndex#1 gives readStates=<<rd1>>. Ready(s1) delivers rd1 and clears readStates (new semantics). ReadIndex#2 (singleton or acked) gives readStates=<<rd2>>. Then Advance(s1) with b.reads=<<rd1>>.

disagreement_witness.proposed_property: With the migrated observer, lostReads = {rd2} \ ({rd2} \cup {rd1}) = {}, so it holds. On the old model both observers yield {rd2}, a true loss.

entries.name: SnapshotAdmission
entries.action: add (defect-detecting; expected to FAIL on new/source)

evidence.source: new/source/raft.go:1398-1420 drops the snapshot if r.id is not in cs.Voters or cs.Learners. It does not check cs.VotersOutgoing, and LearnersNext is a subset of VotersOutgoing (raft.proto ConfState comment). The code comment states the intent: drop only if the 'recipient is not in the config'. The leader keeps Progress for outgoing voters, so it sends them MsgSnap. The update makes joint snapshot restore otherwise functional (confchange.Restore), so this check is now the only gate.
evidence.tests: none cover a snapshot sent to an outgoing-only voter
evidence.contract: A follower that is a member of the snapshot's configuration (VoterIDs or learners), receives a non-stale snapshot beyond its commit, and does not already match the snapshot's index/term must install it, with config equal to the snapshot config.

entries.proposed_expression: Observer at Receive for m.type="MsgSnap": SnapObservation(r,m,a)==[node|->r.id, role|->r.role, term|->r.term, commit|->r.commit, msgTerm|->m.term, snap|->m.snapshot, matches|->Matches(r,m.snapshot.index,m.snapshot.term), afterUsnap|->a.usnap, afterConfig|->a.config, afterCommit|->a.commit]. SnapshotAdmission == \A o\in quality.snapshots: LET s==o.snap IN (o.msgTerm>=o.term /\ ~(o.role="Leader" /\ o.msgTerm=o.term) /\ s.index>o.commit /\ ~o.matches /\ o.node\in VoterIDs(s.config)\cup s.config.learners) => (o.afterUsnap=s /\ o.afterConfig=s.config /\ o.afterCommit=s.index)

disagreement_witness.state_or_transition: Config {s1,s2,s3}. Leader s1 commits V2 <<Remove s3>> with JointExplicit, giving voters={s1,s2}, outgoing={s1,s2,s3}. s1 creates and compacts a snapshot at the joint index. s3 lags (loss/crash), so s1 sends MsgSnap with s.config joint. s3 is a follower with commit < s.index and ~matches; it receives the MsgSnap.
disagreement_witness.proposed_property: violated: s3 is in VoterIDs(s.config) but new/source ignores the snapshot (afterUsnap unchanged). A source fix that also checks VotersOutgoing satisfies it.

entries.notes: Do not weaken the premise to s.config.voters \cup s.config.learners to make the source pass. Doing that would encode the defect as the requirement.

entries.name: AutoLeaveSingleFlight
entries.action: add (defect-detecting; pre-existing defect whose reach is widened by U-B)
entries.change_kind: repair of a pre-existing coverage gap (AutoLeaveAdvance cannot see duplicates)

evidence.source: new/source/raft.go:556-584 (unchanged by the patch): after a successful auto-leave appendEntry, pendingConfIndex is NOT bumped. Any later Advance with appliedCursor >= pendingConfIndex, while config.AutoLeave is still TRUE (the leave entry is not yet applied), appends another empty ConfChangeV2. Applying the second one runs LeaveJoint on a non-joint config ('can't leave a non-joint config', confchange.go:97-99), which panics in applyConfChange (raft.go:1477-1479). Raft's own invariant (pendingConfIndex comment) is 'only one conf change may be pending'. U-B makes AutoLeave survive restart/snapshot restore, so restarted leaders now also reach this code.
evidence.contract: A leader never has more than one unapplied leave-joint entry from its own term.

entries.old_expression: none (AutoLeaveAdvance requires an append on every eligible Advance, with eligibility computed from the implementation's own pendingConf, so duplicates satisfy it)
entries.proposed_expression: AutoLeaveSingleFlight == \A n\in Server: raft[n].alive /\ raft[n].role="Leader" => Cardinality({k\in (raft[n].applied+1)..Last(raft[n]): IsLeave(Hist(raft[n])[k]) /\ Hist(raft[n])[k].term=raft[n].term})<=1

disagreement_witness.state_or_transition: Leader s1, term T. Log index 5 = V2 enter-joint (autoLeave), index 6 = Normal; commit=6; MaxReadySize paginates the committed entries to [5]. Ready, apply 5, Advance(cursor 5) appends leave@7. Ready [6], apply 6, Advance(cursor 6): autoLeave still TRUE and 6>=pendingConf(5), so it appends leave@8.
disagreement_witness.proposed_property: violated: leaves at 7 and 8 are both > applied(6) and from term T. When 8 is applied, NoUnexpectedFatal fires ('invalid configuration transition').

suspected_defects.description: raft.restore ignores snapshots for nodes in VotersOutgoing only (including LearnersNext members). The leader keeps Progress for them and keeps sending MsgSnap; the follower answers with MsgAppResp(index=committed), and the leader's Progress stays in StateSnapshot. If the outgoing majority depends on such a node, the joint config (including its leave entry) cannot commit. This is a liveness defect; safety is unaffected.
suspected_defects.must_not_hide: Do not restrict the SnapshotAdmission premise to voters \cup learners.

suspected_defects.description: pendingConfIndex is not bumped after a successful auto-leave append, so a later Advance (pagination via MaxCommittedSizePerReady, or early Advance) appends a second leave-joint. A user leave proposal is also admitted because pendingConf <= applied. Applying the second leave panics (LeaveJoint on a non-joint config).
suspected_defects.must_not_hide: Do not drop AutoLeaveSingleFlight or redefine AutoLeaveAdvance eligibility to accept duplicates as required behaviour.

suspected_defects.description: numOfPendingConf ignores EntryConfChangeV2, so a node may campaign with an unapplied V2 conf change. CampaignContract requires blocking. This has never been co-checked with V2 workloads.
suspected_defects.detected_by: CampaignDecisionEligibility (keep) once enabled with V2 workloads
suspected_defects.must_not_hide: Do not change CampaignContract's pending to LegacyConfKinds.

unresolved_obligations: U1 Liveness motivation of U-A (a promoted-but-unaware learner's vote is decisive) is a progress property. ElectionProgress exists but is not checked under fault budgets. An optional canary, PromotedLearnerVoteDecisiveNotReached == ~\E w\in history.wins, g\in history.grants: g.learner /\ ~g.pre /\ g.candidate=w.node /\ g.term=w.term /\ g.node\in VoterIDs(w.config) /\ ~JointWon(w.config, w.yes\{g.node}), may be out of bounds.
U2 Whether learner voting preserves ElectionSafety under demotion/promotion races must be established by running MC with the corrected StepVote. The result is unknown at decision time (risk R1).

U3 SnapshotAdmission and AutoLeaveSingleFlight are expected to fail on new/source. The suite owner must decide whether they gate or are tracked as known defects D1/D2. Either way the predicates must not be weakened.

U4 Trace instrumentation (instrumentation-spec.md is not in the workspace) must rename ConfState fields and emit RawNode Ready-time acceptance. This cannot be verified here; TraceCorrespondence will fail until it is migrated.

U5 Restore of malformed ConfStates (AutoLeave without outgoing, learners-only, LearnersNext not in outgoing) panics in the source. The model excludes these via ConfigWellFormed/SnapshotValid. The Storage/caller contract for well-formed ConfStates is assumed, not checked.
U6 RecoveryMode=AppliedAdapter fidelity assumes the adapter returns ConfigOf(savedApp) as InitialState's ConfState, including joint fields. This is a caller-contract assumption.
U7 ReadyOwnership could additionally require prevSS acceptance at Ready for RawNodes (affects hasSS of the next Ready). The observer does not record it; this is left optional.

U8 D3 (V2 not counted as a pending conf at Hup) is pre-existing and outside this update. It is listed so that enabling CampaignDecisionEligibility with V2 workloads is not mistaken for an update regression.
